description: This file defines a custom JSON converter for the StreamId type, enabling serialization and deserialization of StreamId objects to and from JSON strings.

classes.name: StreamIdJsonConverter
classes.description: A JSON converter for the StreamId type, enabling custom serialization and deserialization logic.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a JSON string and converts it into a StreamId object, throwing exceptions if the JSON token is not a string or if the string is empty.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes a StreamId object into its string representation in JSON format.
